name: gizza-ai/image-convert
summary: Convert an image to a different format (JPEG, PNG, WebP).

tool.description: Convert an image at the given URL to a different format. Supported formats: jpeg, png, webp. Optional quality (1-100) controls JPEG/WebP compression; ignored for PNG. Use when the user asks to change the file format or compress an image.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to an image.

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for jpeg/webp; ignored for png. Default 85.
